sections.kicker: Prepared for Studio Octava by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Studio Octava says its best line in Spanish on Instagram. The site says what every studio says.
sections.keep: Your project photography, like the dark house that vanishes into the canopy. It shows the idea better than any sentence.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: from first sketch to keys in hand
pins.what: The site describes a service chain any studio in Costa Rica could list.
pins.why: Design, plan and manage is the process. It does not say why this studio and not the one next door.
pins.how: Lead with the belief that shapes the work, then the process.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Clients compare studios on process and fee, because the site gives them nothing else.

pins.quote: diseño que no busca destacar, sino pertenecer
pins.what: Your best positioning line lives in one Spanish caption.
pins.why: Design that seeks to belong, not to stand out, is a real point of view for homes in the jungle.
pins.how: Move this idea to the top of the site and the bio, in both languages.
pins.label: Your caption
pins.cost: The idea that sets you apart is read by followers and missed by buyers.

pins.area: Pale leaf photo under a washed out headline on the site
pins.what: The site hides the dark, sharp houses the Instagram shows.
pins.why: A grey veil sits over the one thing that differs from other studios, the work itself.
pins.how: Open with a project photograph at full strength.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: First impressions look like a template, not like a studio with a point of view.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Studio Octava. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out.
